# SoundPan <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
SoundPan:Void sound:Int32, pan:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sound` | In | Int32 | required | A handle from [LoadSound](LoadSound). |
| `pan` | In | Float32 | required | -1 is only left, 0 the middle and 1 only right. |

## Description

Sets the stereo position that channels of this sound start with. Channels that are already playing keep theirs: use [ChannelPan](ChannelPan) for those.

## Differences

* A debug build (`-d`) stops the program when the sound is 0 (a sound that failed to load) or does not exist, other builds ignore the command, see [Debug handle checks](Debug-Handle-Checks).
